qualityGate.reason: The Playwright tests are valid TypeScript and use Playwright API correctly. All locators and assertions are awaited and properly used. However, the selector strategy uses hard-coded data-test attributes which could be brittle. The navigation verification is too generic, only checking for '/product/' in the URL without confirming the exact product. Also, the test titles do not preserve the testCaseId and there is redundancy in asserting visibility of many similar product elements instead of a loop or more scalable approach.
